baseline.rule: same lookback + switch_buffer + entry_fraction with R2 removed and no target-vol

data_snapshot.pool_rule: QQQ/EWG/EWJ/GLD from 2007 start; CN_CYB_399006 joins from own data with no backfill

execution_assumptions.signal: close-to-close weighted-slope ranking, score range 0..5, switch buffer, R2 removed
execution_assumptions.r2_removed_execution: r2 execution threshold is set to 0.0 in run_staged_entry; output labels use r2_none
execution_assumptions.staged_entry: enter new asset with selected initial fraction; fill to 100% on later down day if signal remains unchanged
execution_assumptions.target_vol: 80-day realized vol, next-day effective scale, max leverage 1.5, scale rebalance threshold 0.075
execution_assumptions.overlays: none in this layer beyond switch buffer, staged entry, and target-vol
execution_assumptions.mixed_market_calendar: diagnostic A-share calendar with US proxy forward-filled; trades on stale trade legs blocked
